Each NAME.json is the stdout of `atlc run examples/NAME.toml` and NAME.args the args of `atlc spec examples/NAME.toml --json` (one per line, the examples directory written @EXAMPLES@), from atlc 3f9ce62 against algotradelib 7b16b00.
@EXAMPLES@ is now cmdatl's examples/, copies of atlc 7448851's examples, which differ from 3f9ce62's in comments only.
To re-record after the examples, atlc's report or the library's report change: run those two commands again on cmdatl's examples/ with an atlc that still has them (3f9ce62) and the library, and write each output over its file, the examples directory replaced by @EXAMPLES@.
